READ-ONLY OCI COLLECTION
Collect a fresh snapshot

  
Credentials go only to this computer's loopback helper. A one-shot process signs OCI reads in memory, then exits. This app does not save the key, passphrase or credential fields.

  

  

    

      
      
      
      
      
      
      
    
Services

    
    
    
Scans root and all active compartments in the selected regions. IAM collection needs additional reader permissions. User memberships are not collected here. Any API error stops collection; your existing snapshot remains available.

    

  

  
Key fields clear as soon as collection starts. Each attempt needs credentials again. Avoid shared computers and untrusted extensions. The app cannot guarantee memory erasure from browser/OS internals. Only Save snapshot writes an inventory file, containing no credentials.
